title: Waveform Decomposition and Fourier Analysis
full_prompt: Write a ManimGL script that visualizes the decomposition of an audio waveform into its Fourier components. The scene should first plot a full waveform using a passing flash effect. Then, it should zoom in on a specific segment of the waveform, scaling the axes and graph to fill the frame, and transition to a new set of axes. Next, it should prepare the scene for a 3D perspective by rotating the mobjects and reorienting the camera frame. Finally, it should perform a Fourier transform (FFT) on the signal segment and break it down into individual sine wave components aligned along a 3D axis.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using Manim Community camera syntax instead of ManimGL's self.camera.frame
common_failure_modes.note: ManimGL uses self.camera.frame.reorient() and self.camera.frame.stretch() which are not compatible with Manim Community's Camera class.
The script relies on an external .wav file. Mocking or generating a synthetic waveform is recommended if the file is missing.
